summary: Greenpro Capital Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that its Board and stockholders approved a 1-for-10 reverse stock split via written consent (11,012,377 shares, ~60.97% voting power). No shareholder meeting was held. The split aims to raise the per-share trading price to address perceptions tied to its low-priced stock and support strategic initiatives, including a digital banking license application in Malaysia. The company will file a Schedule 14C information statement; the split is expected on or about July 26, 2026, pending Nevada filing and exchange processes. No deal terms apply as this is a capital structure adjustment, not a special situation.
